name: Riyad Capital
legal_name: Riyad Capital (a sole shareholder closed joint stock company)
founded: CMA licence 07070-37 dated 19 Jun 2007; CR 1010239234 dated 24 Oct 2007 (then an LLC); operations commenced February 2008 (AR 2025); became a closed joint stock company on 28 Feb 2017 (FS note 1).
ownership_summary: 100% owned by Riyad Bank: SAR 500m capital divided into 250 million shares (AR 2025; FS note 1). Statutory reserve SAR 150m. Riyad Bank filed in July 2025 to list part of the company on Tadawul; as of 12 Oct 2026 no approval, prospectus or listing was found.
government_link: Indirect. The parent, Riyad Bank, shows PIF 21.8% and GOSI 10.4% in its AR 2025 shareholder chart (see sa-riyad).
group_structure: 100% subsidiary of Riyad Bank (sa-riyad), reported as the bank's 'Investment banking and brokerage' segment. Double counting: Riyad Capital's balance sheet, income and AUM are consolidated in the bank; never add this record to sa-riyad. The segment (H1 2026 operating income SAR 493m; total assets SAR 4.67bn) is close to but not identical with the standalone firm. The company has no subsidiaries other than unnamed SPVs that safeguard fund assets (AR 2025); FS note 1 also mentions immaterial subsidiaries that are not consolidated. Siblings under Riyad Bank include Jeel Digital Innovation (technology), 1957 Ventures Fund (fintech VC) and Riyad Financial Markets (see sa-riyad). Riyad Bank provides some support services under service agreements.

subsidiaries.name: Special purpose vehicles for safeguarding investment fund assets (names not given)
subsidiaries.activity: Hold fund assets under CMA rules; separate statements not included in the annual report

footprint: Head office: Financial Boulevard, Al Aqeeq District, Riyadh. Investment centres in Saudi Arabia (list not captured; 'Riyad Capital Centers' and 'Locate us' pages exist). Digital channels: Riyad Capital Online, apps, IVR, ATM. International trading in 23 markets via Riyad Global (checked 12 Oct 2026).
customer_segments: Retail and affluent investors (many via Riyad Bank), high-net-worth and institutional clients (DPM, advisory), corporates and issuers (investment banking), institutional investors and fund managers (securities services, custody and fund administration).
business_lines: Asset management (public funds, private funds, DPM, real estate, private equity and venture capital, Global Money Market and Fixed Income); wealth management and investment advisory; brokerage (local, GCC, international, margin financing, institutional trading, algorithmic execution); securities services and custody (AUC over SAR 1tn, fund services, paying agent for sukuk); corporate investment banking (ECM, DCM, sukuk and bonds, structured finance, M&A); research. FY2025 revenue (SAR '000): asset management 418,344; brokerage 347,680; corporate investment banking 32,561; securities services and custody 69,983; special commission 116,039; FVTPL gains 40,057; dividends 10,440; total 1,035,007.

capabilities.wealth_summary: Riyad Capital is Riyad Bank's 100%-owned, CMA-licensed (07070-37) investment arm covering asset management, wealth management, brokerage, securities services and corporate investment banking. It managed SAR 97.5bn at end-2025 and SAR 101.3bn at 30 Jun 2026 (parent slide), and held SAR 1,048bn in custody (a record) at end-2025. FY2025 revenue was SAR 1,035m (first year above SAR 1bn; +16%) and net income SAR 664m, with asset management fees SAR 418m, brokerage SAR 348m and securities services SAR 70m. The shelf is mostly its own: 14 equity funds, 9 multi-asset funds (Shariah and conventional variants), fixed income and money market funds, REITs, real estate (over SAR 26bn), private equity and venture funds (over SAR 1.7bn), plus discretionary portfolios; advisory says funds are 'managed in-house and via 3rd party providers'. Retail investing runs in separate apps: Riyad Capital (Saudi market, with the 'Mostshary' goal-based planning service) and Riyad Global (US and international stocks, options and ETFs, login on clientam.com), both needing a Riyad Online login and a Riyad Capital account. Riyad Bank filed in July 2025 to list part of Riyad Capital on Tadawul (no approval found by 12 Oct 2026), and its board was reconstituted by 2026 under new chairman Waleed Fatani.

private_banking.detail: Private banking sits in the parent bank (Private Banking, Diamond, Golden, see sa-riyad). Riyad Capital has a Wealth Management division (Head: Abdulaziz AlRegaibah, an ex-Riyad Bank private and Golden banking professional) and a DPM service for 'institutional and high net-worth clients'; no eligibility thresholds published.

asset_management.detail: AUM SAR 97.5bn (31 Dec 2025), SAR 101.3bn (30 Jun 2026). Website: 14 equity funds, 9 multi-asset funds, fixed income, money market and REIT categories, DPM and private funds. 2025 launches: Riyad Fixed Income Funds 3 and 4 (private placements), Riyad Financing Fund 5, Riyad Monthly Distribution Multi-Asset Fund (over SAR 250m by year-end), five real estate funds. SAR Liquidity Fund grew over 300%; DPM AUM +50%; seven multi-asset funds in the top ten of their category; Riyad Al Jarei Fund topped public-fund performance. All funds and portfolios moved to Bloomberg AIM in 2025. FT Asset Management Excellence Awards Middle East 2025: Best Private Equity Manager.

brokerage.detail: Saudi market via Riyad Capital Online/Mobile and a new app with TradingView charts; GCC; international (23 markets listed incl. US, Canada, Mexico, Europe, Hong Kong, Australia, Singapore, Japan; stocks, bonds, options, ETFs; no annual account fee; a commission-free 'Lite' tier with extended US pre-market hours). H1 2026 value traded SAR 44.7bn (-30% YoY). 2025 additions: client rewards programme, face login, portfolio views for real estate funds and Murabaha, securities lending ('yield enhancement'), and an algorithmic trading system supporting HFT and market-making for institutions. Margin financing and IVR/ATM/centres channels. FY2025 brokerage commission SAR 347.7m (+24%). Market share not disclosed.

digital_investing.detail: 'Riyad Capital' app (iOS seller Riyad Capital; v2.0.5, 14 Jun 2026; first released 28 Aug 2022; 291 ratings, average 3.09): local trading, interactive charts (TickerChart and TradingView), watchlists, alerts, research, Mostshary planning, referral programme. 'Riyad Global' app (v10.07, 21 Sep 2026; first released 1 Mar 2019; 63 ratings, average 2.84): stocks, options and ETFs in global markets. Both require a Riyad Online login (same as the bank) and a Riyad Capital investment account; the website page does not list fund subscription or IPO in the apps. Investment account opening starts from Riyad Capital Online.

advisory.detail: Investment advisory for individuals and institutions through a 'specially developed advisory process', dedicated team of advisors, covering local and international equities; offers tailored portfolios, DPM, tailor-made structured products and CMA-registered funds. Chief Investment Officer's office publishes economic and investment views and runs all clients' multi-asset portfolios; research covers 50 listed companies (43 in 2024).

discretionary.detail: Discretionary Portfolio Management for institutional and high-net-worth clients, built on an Investment Policy Statement and Investment Management Agreement; DPM AUM grew over 50% in 2025 and the investable universe was widened to global equities and alternatives. No minimum or fees published.

model_portfolios_robo.detail: 'Mostashary' (Mostshary) robo-advisory service launched in 2025 uses Riyad Capital multi-asset funds as the investment tools, with three steps: goal, target amount and risk appetite (App Store description), 'providing users with diversified strategies aligned with their respective risk profiles' (AR 2025). Inside the Riyad Capital app; the website pages on apps and advisory do not mention it. Launch date, minimums and technology vendor not found.

funds_platform.detail: Advisory page states mutual funds are CMA-registered and 'managed in-house and via 3rd Party Providers'. The public funds pages list only Riyad-branded funds; no third-party fund platform provider or named third-party fund manager found.

structured_products.detail: Advisory offers 'tailor made structured products'; no product list, minimum or issuer named. Riyad Capital also advises corporates on structured finance (corporate investment banking).

private_markets.detail: Real estate: over SAR 26bn managed (83 properties in 18 cities across three continents), five funds launched in 2025. Private equity and venture capital: over SAR 1.7bn across five funds (Riyad Taqnia Fund, Riyad FinTech Fund, 1957 Ventures Fund, Riyad Venture Capital Opportunities Fund I investing in March Capital Partners Fund IV, Riyad Pre-IPO Opportunities Fund I). Led the 2025 round for Ninja (over SAR 1bn, unicorn status). Riyad Taqnia Fund exited investments for SAR 150m proceeds (gross TVPI 3x).

islamic_wealth.detail: Shariah-compliant variants across the shelf: Riyad Saudi Equity Sharia Fund, Riyad Global Equity Sharia Fund, Monthly Distribution multi-asset fund and Sharia versions of the four risk-profile multi-asset funds; the firm itself is not Shariah-only (conventional variants exist). An Annual Shariah Committee Report is published (file labelled 2024).
